set.body:
Outcome: make ordinary mapping workflows interpretable, policy-explicit and independently usable while preserving producer authority, truthful missingness and existing model semantics.

Requested by owner: review the six-finding audit carefully and lodge a tagged executable epic. Baseline inspected: 6702a28ec9bde57729eb9ec09a7180fa92aa73b3 on 2026-10-20. This is planned work, not authorization to implement or evidence of completion.

Reviewed findings:
1. MappingPipeline.execute fixes reference level 0 and Sherlock; lexical nomination and ONNX batch registration also fix level 0. Selection must propagate before pricing; filtering evidence afterward is forbidden.
2. LocalReference.compute already exists publicly. Missing is registered reference-only execution/publication; MappingRun.Execution currently requires both producers.
3. README limits distortion efficacy claims; ordinary summaries need visible measure/claim boundaries. Checked fidelity states are consequences of implemented gates, not validated error detection.
4. Batch manifests already retain failures and processing statuses. inspect counts run creation, not measured-unit coverage. Preserve measured uniform evidence, overflow, unavailable support and failure as distinct coordinates. Differential missingness is a risk to test, not an observed participant effect.
5. ADR 0019 explicitly disclaims endpoint continuity. Independent 343-path enumeration of a three-unit, equal-cost, two-source/five-external fixture gives reference source mass 2/7 and interior right limit 1/2 for later rows; no compiled Scala run was performed. Interior temperature is fixed at 0.15; reference temperature is configurable; lambda=1 uses Sherlock constrained decisions. Keep v1 semantics and exact endpoint records unchanged.
6. hsmm.scala retains adjacent state-product transitions and flows. Profile scoring, inference, flow storage and export time/memory before candidate expansion or backend changes. Complexity is not measured performance.

Engineering completion: children A-H are independently reviewed, qualified and landed; summary denominators reconcile to retained records; policy selection is content-bound; reference-only runs have checked provenance and independent export readback; weighted semantics have a runnable discriminating oracle; a reproducible workload baseline and measured operating envelope are recorded. Any adverse or blocked outcome remains visible. No broad assurance rating substitutes for these receipts.

Research disposition: preserve existing E1 bd-01M50KBFT26DRB77VFHPRHYNA2, E2 bd-01M50KC744836VNJ8F8A4AHNWH, E3 bd-01M50KD0NHVPCEHGZND9H18M6E and instrument repair bd-01M2TAAQNS7RCCBBM8WFFZF6ZZ. E1 already covers fixed-organization unequal-quality controls, denominator/coverage rules and scientific freeze; instrument repair already has three review-stage children. Do not create another efficacy or risk-coverage project, adopt their claims or reopen their closed predecessors. This epic closes on engineering acceptance plus explicit handoff of relevant artifacts to those existing issues; it does not close research gates or establish scientific utility. Do not add research prerequisites to ordinary engineering work.

Assurance table disposition: strong inspected mechanisms (generators, laws, numerical courts) are not a fresh gate pass, exhaustive exported-instance/provider coverage or current hosted CI. Refresh evidence for each changed surface; retain current CI/version coverage limitations explicitly rather than commissioning an unrelated library-wide audit.

Scope boundaries: no new solver/backend, wider candidate budget, calibration, continuity repair, empirical study, private/gold data read, release scheduling change or default-model replacement. ADR approval is required before new public vocabulary/execution authority (SD5); owner scientific/data decisions remain on existing issues.

Execution order: start A coverage, B interpretation metadata and H baseline as independent slices (serial gates); C numeric witness is independent. D freezes the bounded API contract before E selectable policy and F reference authority. G integrates F into the facade and consumes A/B output contracts. Preserve default bytes/identities where promised by D and version intentional schema changes. E and F need not block each other. H records current workloads now; G adds reference-only measurements using that harness. Suggested priorities P1 for A/B/C/D, P2 for E/F/G/H. Parent/child containment is distinct from blocking dependencies. Claim children, not this container.

Sources: pipeline/MappingPipeline.scala execute, lexical, batchOnnx, inspect, artifacts; align/localreference.scala compute/row; align/mappingrun.scala compute/Execution; align/reconstruction.scala Profile/DecisionPolicy; align/structuralweight.scala; align/hsmm.scala run/transitionRow; docs/adr/0019-mapping-measurement-policy.md; docs/refactor/prospective-evaluation-20261015.md; README.md.

Delivery rules: claim this bounded child with an explicit actor and mote begin before implementation; reserve only affected paths. One writer and at most one independent helper, one heavy gate at a time. No change to protected data admission, calibration authority or existing scientific acceptance. For code changes, compute scope with bash tools/reference-scope.sh BASE_SHA CANDIDATE_SHA in a verified standalone clone/export, use CI fatal warnings, all affected platforms and StoryAtlas checks for consumed surfaces. Record exact SHA, commands, exits and Passed/Failed/skipped totals; format last. Require independent exact-SHA review (SD2/SD6), external-package construction probes for new checked boundaries and named compiling mutation kills for new guards. Documentation-only work uses T2 review and format/integrity checks. Close only after the accepted slice lands within owner authorization; distinguish local, hosted and consumer evidence. Split further before editing if a child exceeds about one day. No publication/release or main movement is authorized by this planning request.
set.title: [mapping audit] Explicit policies, reference-only workflow and honest coverage
